ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   B. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   C. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   D. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   B. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Swadaqah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
